note: 25 pages, 37 measured regions on 16 pages. Fifteen figure items, six table rows, sixteen refusals, against twenty-one printed exhibit designators (Figure 1.1, 4.1, 4.2, 5.1-5.6, 6.1 twice, 6.2, 6.3 (a), 6.3 (b), 7.1 and Table 3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 5.1, 6.2) with one duplicate and one table number that never prints, plus one unnumbered chart on the p24 spread.
rules: Thirty-seven measured regions on sixteen of the twenty-five pages account for every exhibit in the paper and for every box the layout pass emitted: fifteen figure items, six table rows and sixteen refusals [caption.numbering].

Table 3.1 is a declared deficit: its measured box stops at y 170.9, one rule below the header band, and the eleven symbol rows NPP, C(t), P(t), Q(t), D(t), R(t), alpha, tau, T, eta and W print unruled at y 184.2 to 496.3 outside it, so the row is recorded as cols 3 rows 1 header_rows 1 rather than as a twelve-row grid [table.rows].

Figure 6.1 prints twice on p15: once as the AHP hierarchy artwork over a caption printed BELOW it (p15 r1) and once as the ruled 1-9 relative-comparison table over a caption printed ABOVE it (p15 r2, family table-as-figure) - the only duplicate designator in the paper [caption.position].
The numbering skips Table 6.1 entirely: it never prints, no prose line names it, and the table sequence runs 3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 5.1, 6.2 [caption.numbering].

Caption sides hold the LaTeX convention: thirteen of the fourteen captioned figure items print their caption BELOW the art - 1.8 to 7.7 pt under the bottom edge - and that includes the composite 6.3 (a)/(b) pair, the single exception being the mis-captioned scale table on p15 r2, forty pt above its grid; all six table captions print ABOVE the grid at 14.2 to 29.7 pt [caption.position].

All six grids are Word-style tables drawn with horizontal rules only - one rule for Table 3.1, and three, five, three, three and three for Tables 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 5.1 and 6.2 - with not one vertical rule anywhere in the file, so rule_style is booktabs on every row [table.rule_style].

Only four of the twenty-one exhibit designators are ever named in prose: Table 3.1 on p6, Table 4.2 on p9, and Figures 5.5 and 5.6 on p13, the two figures a page before they print - every other exhibit, Table 4.1 and the rest included, is never cited [mention.count].

The two p13 regions are one unnumbered pseudo-code listing cut by the horizontal rule at y 475, not two exhibits: the body text runs on at the same measure across the cut, so the pair is refused as not-an-exhibit plus fragment-of-other [caption.numbering].

Pages 23 and 24 are a two-page magazine spread - a full-bleed photograph with the 72 pt display headline "Harvesting? / Protection?" - holding twelve measured regions and not one printed exhibit number; eleven of them are refused as page furniture and the twelfth is the six-series line chart that p24 calls "the above figure", recorded as an item with caption_source none [caption.numbering].

Every one of the fifteen numbered figure regions holds exactly one embedded raster: nothing is drawn by the PDF in a figure, while the p13 listing, the p16 display maths and the spread furniture are the file's vector regions [geometry.family].

The p24 chart carries no figure number and no caption line at all, only the prose pointer "The above figure shows that with the increase of deforestation ratio" ten points beneath it - and that pointer is unusable as a plain substring because the spread wraps two columns into one text-layer line, "The above figure shows that with the increase     ground temperature. Therefore, it is nec-", so its mention is recorded against that line with an empty style list [mention.style].
